ideas.pitch: Real-time satellite and IoT anomaly detection platform monitoring urban heat islands and industrial compliance in Atlanta.
ideas.title: GeoStream-Atlanta
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-difficulty spatial data processing with real-world utility, echoing patterns from GeoNex-ATLAS and iot-smart-home-ai-ops.

ideas.pitch: Automated bias-detection and mitigation platform specifically tailored for clinical readmission prediction models.
ideas.title: FairLens-Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Merges fairness tracking with high-accuracy healthcare analytics, building directly on proven concepts from patient-readmission-prediction and fairlens-ai-.

ideas.pitch: An automated 3-turn metacognition benchmarking framework to test the self-correction and reasoning limits of local LLMs.
ideas.title: Metacog-Eval
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the rigorous evaluation paradigm that won the Google DeepMind x Kaggle AGI hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous NGINX and server log anomaly detection dashboard that translates raw operational data into instant natural language insights.
ideas.title: LogSight-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages live data visualization and anomaly detection patterns that successfully won the UCC ACM Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence pipeline that instantly transforms unstructured local video feeds into fully searchable queryable databases.
ideas.title: DataQuery-Video
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy data indexing and multimodal search capabilities proven by the LibrAI data and design hackathon winner.
